title: Banking Application Compromise
story: Following the credential compromise, the attacker begins probing the Black Falcon Bank web application. Monitoring systems record an abnormal transaction search, access to a restricted administration path and the creation of a suspicious PHP file.
objective: Reproduce the suspicious search behaviour, identify the exposed administration route, correlate the uploaded artifact with network and integrity logs, and verify its MD5 hash.
